On September 23, 2026, Stitch Fix, Inc. (the “Company”) announced its financial results for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2026, ended August 1, 2026. In the press release, the Company also announced that it would be holding a conference call on September 23, 2026, at 2:00 p.m Pacific Time to discuss its financial results for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2026. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K (this “Current Report”) and incorporated by reference herein. The information included in Item 2.02 of this Current Report and the exhibits attached hereto are being furnished and shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference into any other filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, regardless of any general incorporation language in any such filing.
